items.headline: Dubai resale market surges while off-plan demand cools
items.summary: TradingView notes an increase in secondary market activity alongside a slowdown in off-plan sales. Buyers are shifting focus toward ready properties.
items.why: Highlights a major shift in buyer preference between ready and off-plan assets.
items.impact_reason: Indicates a shift in transaction patterns.

bullets: On Monday 19 October, DLD recorded 702 sales worth AED 1.7bn, down 3.1% compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan share reached 69.2%, compared to the 7-day average of 65.2%.
The median price was AED 1,720 per sq ft, up 4.3% over the last 30 days and up 1.0% compared to last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were Dubai South with 290 sales, JVC with 188 sales, and Majan with 126 sales.
In September new rental contracts, a 1BR apartment in JVC had a median rent of AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: The UAE has held its base interest rate at 3.9 percent, which helps stabilize mortgage costs and buyer financing conditions.
Dubai has greenlit a massive multi-million dollar investment strategy, providing public funding that shapes urban expansion and asset valuations.
Off-plan property demand continues to expand across UAE residential projects, signaling strong buyer interest in the current market.

items.headline: Golden Visa holders can secure emergency return permits swiftly
items.summary: UAE Golden Visa holders who lose passports abroad can obtain quick return permits within thirty minutes. The fast process ensures residents face minimal travel disruptions.
items.why: It impacts long-term investors and residents maintaining residency status while traveling internationally.
items.impact_reason: Affects residency and travel security for key investor segments.

items.headline: Landlords barred from cutting utilities during tenancy disputes
